prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat pyproject.toml; find src -name '*.py' | head -50; mypy 2>&1 | tail -50
cat src/trailhead/geo.py src/trailhead/report.py; grep -rn "heading\|compass\|initial_bearing" tests src | grep -v "^src/trailhead/report.py\|^src/trailhead/geo.py"
cat tests/test_report.py; grep -rni "loop\|heading" --include=*.md --include=*.py . | grep -v "^./src/trailhead/report.py\|^./tests/test_report.py"; git log --stat | head

python - <<'EOF'
import re,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path("src/trailhead/geo.py"); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("def initial_bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):","def initial_bearing(lat1: float, lon1: float, lat2: float, lon2: float) -> float:")
p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path("src/trailhead/report.py"); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("def _heading(track: Track) -> str | None:","def _heading(track: Track) -> str:")
s=s.replace("        return None\n","        return \"loop\"\n")
p.write_text(s)
EOF
git diff --stat; mypy && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; ruff check src 2>&1 | tail -2
